value.description: What the listbox's value becomes when this option is selected. Without it, the option's text.

selected.description: The option is selected. A script that sets it selects the option.

disabled.description: It cannot be chosen or focused.

root.note: A row. highlighted: its listbox's thumb is its tint (C32); the option names itself the thumb's anchor and paints no face of its own for it. selected: face solid, no relief, over the thumb.

notYet: A disabled option still dispatches click to a listener the author adds; the listbox ignores it.
